facts.event: Tilde 在修复 Faoldun 城耗时一个月里，尽量不去想阵亡的 Guwetha，而 Ladbh 早已躲进森林。
facts.relation: Tilde—Guwetha（旧日同伴，已死）／Tilde—Ladbh（女巫，逃亡）
facts.anchor: I thought about Guwetha as little as I could during the month it took to bring Faoldun city

facts.event: 守城贵妇 Lady Henoveva 主动让出自己的居室给 Tilde，Tilde 拒绝了。
facts.numbers: her own chambers, which I refused
facts.anchor: Lady Henoveva, who had held the castle, offered me her own chambers, which I refused

facts.event: Ysel 用 Tilde 给的 Ardweni 木样做成一根蛇头手杖，带来献给她以示敬意。
facts.anchor: come to show me the staff she had designed from the Ardweni wood samples I had given her

facts.event: 红王子（自封国王的 Alar）处处跟随 Tilde，微笑鞠躬、送诗集、送《翼之言》与 Cynghal 史书，再问她读完没有。
facts.relation: Tilde—Alar（继子／追求者兼政治操盘者）
facts.numbers: books of poems, the word of the Wing
facts.anchor: bowing with a smile, sending me books of poems, the word of the Wing, the history of Cynghal

facts.event: Tilde 需要 Elise，便让她教自己 Galenish 女子的仪态、发式与礼数，并借她掩饰自己的心思。
facts.anchor: I needed her, and she came to me, so I used her to teach me Galenish femininity

facts.event: 入秋转冷、新谷入仓、尸堆清完之后，众人备好庆功宴；Tilde 在偏殿换装，Muirenn 请求上高桌侍奉获准。
facts.anchor: as the first breath of autumn came cold, fresh grain brought in and the charnel mounds were cleared

facts.event: 宴上 Gaisa 讥讽 Tilde 是“战士文化的女王”并嘲笑 Elise 不识字，Isen 反手打了 Gaisa 的头，警告他们别拿妹妹的名声说嘴。
facts.anchor: Keep our sister’s name out of your mouths if you have nothing good to say,’ said Isen

facts.event: Tilde 饮下被做手脚的酒，腹中灼烧、视线发黑，Liran 一声“Stand”便使她四肢不听使唤地自行站起。
facts.relation: Liran—Tilde（夫妻／国王与王后，下毒者与受害者）
facts.numbers: The wine burned in me, settling strange
facts.anchor: The wine burned in me, settling strange, and I felt wrong, rotten in my skin
